command: set -euo pipefail; base=/workspace/.toolchains; ver=1.27.1; dest=$base/go$ver; mkdir -p $base; if [ ! -x $dest/bin/go ]; then meta=$base/go-dl.json; curl -fsSL 'https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json&include=all' -o $meta; sha=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('$meta')); print(next(f['sha256'] for r in d if r['version']=='go$ver' for f in r['files'] if f['filename']=='go$ver.linux-amd64.tar.gz'))"); curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/go$ver.linux-amd64.tar.gz" -o $base/go$ver.linux-amd64.tar.gz; echo "$sha  $base/go$ver.linux-amd64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; rm -rf $base/go; tar -C $base -xzf $base/go$ver.linux-amd64.tar.gz; mv $base/go $dest; fi; $dest/bin/go version
